description: Study guide from notes — Turn lecture notes, a chapter or an article into a study guide: summary, key terms with definitions (each checked against the source text), concepts, practice questions with answers tagged recall/understanding/application, mnemonics, common mistakes, estimated study time and a ready markdown guide. Optional: level (e.g. high school, college), questions (3-15, default 8). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: e.g. Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy in chloroplasts. Chlorophyll absorbs mostly red and blue light. The light reactions make ATP and NADPH; the Calvin cycle uses them to fix carbon dioxide into sugar.
